widgets.markdown:
## Log cost estimator
Estimated cost of your logs, from the prices under **Parameters**. The defaults are East US list prices in USD (November 2026); yours depend on region and agreement. **Currency** ({Currency}) is only a label: enter the prices in that currency. Pick the **Workspace** first.

Not covered: the Defender for Servers (500 MB per server per day) and Microsoft 365 E5 (5 MB per user per day) allowances, which are taken off only on the bill, so the tables they cover show higher here; the 5 GB per month Log Analytics free grant; query and search charges for Basic and Auxiliary tables; the Sentinel data lake, dedicated clusters, search jobs and restores; taxes and negotiated discounts.

widgets.title: Billable GB per day, top 10 tables

widgets.markdown: Per day is averaged over the whole UTC days in the time range; monthly = per day × 30. Retention counts the days kept beyond the free ones ({FreeRetentionDays} for Analytics, 30 for Basic and Auxiliary) at {RetentionPrice} per GB-month, which assumes those days are long-term retention: Analytics (interactive) retention beyond the free days costs more (about 0.10 per GB-month in East US), so set the price to that if you extended it. Commitment tiers apply to the whole workspace's Analytics volume, whatever tables are picked, and use East US tier prices scaled by your Analytics price ÷ 4.30, an approximation.

Defender XDR tables measured in advanced hunting over the last 7 days, as if they were sent to the workspace as Analytics. The first 30 days in advanced hunting are part of the Defender licence. `estimate_data_size` runs 10–25% above the billed size, so the result is scaled by **{XdrFactor}**. This counts every table here, including ones you already stream: those are on **Current cost** too, so don't add them twice. On a very large tenant the measurement can time out.

widgets.title: Defender XDR tables, per month if streamed

query.text:
// Each table on its own: estimate_data_size(*) over a union would count every other table's empty columns too.
let t = materialize(union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceProcessEvents"),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkEvents"),
    (DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceFileEvents"),
    (DeviceRegistryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceRegistryEvents"),
    (DeviceLogonEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceLogonEvents"),
    (DeviceImageLoadEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceImageLoadEvents"),
    (DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceEvents"),
    (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceInfo"),
    (DeviceNetworkInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkInfo"),
    (DeviceFileCertificateInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceFileCertificateInfo"),
    (EmailEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailEvents"),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailAttachmentInfo"),
    (EmailUrlInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailUrlInfo"),
    (EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailPostDeliveryEvents"),
    (UrlClickEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "UrlClickEvents"),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityLogonEvents"),
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityQueryEvents"),
    (IdentityDirectoryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityDirectoryEvents"),
    (CloudAppEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "CloudAppEvents"),
    (AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "AlertInfo"),
    (AlertEvidence | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "AlertEvidence")
| where Rows > 0
| extend GBPerDay = Bytes / 1e9 / 7 * {XdrFactor}
| extend PerMonth = GBPerDay * 30 * {PriceAnalytics});
t
| project Table, RowsPerDay = round(Rows / 7.0), GBPerDay = round(GBPerDay, 3), PerMonth = round(PerMonth, 2)
| order by GBPerDay desc
| union (t | summarize GBPerDay = round(sum(GBPerDay), 3), PerMonth = round(sum(PerMonth), 2) | extend Table = "Total")

widgets.markdown: Estimate a table before you connect it: from **events per day** × **bytes per event** (× 0.75, as billed size is about a quarter smaller than the raw JSON), or from a **similar table** you already collect, measured on yesterday's billed size. The similar table is an Analytics one: scanning a Basic or Auxiliary table is billed.
